recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait composition featuring a staggered vertical arrangement of subjects in matching suits, set against a white background with a distinctive blue typographic 'echo' effect at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered diagonal alignment of three male subjects from bottom-left to center-right.
Vertical stacking of three typographic layers with decreasing opacity and shifting styles.
High-contrast blue typography against a neutral, slightly textured white background.
Tight framing of subjects in formal mid-century attire.
coreInvariants: The blue 'echo' text effect at the top margin.
The specific shade of mid-tone royal blue.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal line; the bottom-most is largest in the foreground, the middle is central, and the top-most is slightly smaller and to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, solid blue text at the very top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top text, moves down through the faded text layers, then follows the diagonal line of faces from top-right to bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white space surrounding the subjects and between the text and the heads.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Grey/Brown (suit textures and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue text contrasting with the muted, naturalistic tones of the photographic subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on repetition and transparency effects.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Repetition of the same condensed sans-serif with varying opacity and fill styles (solid, 50% opacity, outline only).
graphicDevices: Horizontal waveform lines flanking the top metadata text.
Circular seal/logo on the left mid-ground.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed verticality of the primary title.
Provides the clean, mid-century grotesque look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three men in grey 1960s suits and thin ties, arranged in a diagonal staggered line from bottom-left to top-right against a clean white background. The lighting should be bright and even, typical of mid-century commercial photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three rows of extra-condensed sans-serif text at the top. Top row: solid blue. Middle row: 50% opacity blue. Bottom row: blue outline only. Add a small 'STEREO' label at the very top center flanked by thin waveform lines.

verificationChecks: Is the text extra-condensed and uppercase?
Are there three layers of text with decreasing visual weight?
Are the subjects in matching 1960s formal attire?
Is the background a clean, slightly textured white?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
Opacity levels of the text layers
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the original artists

avoid: Messy or overlapping text that obscures faces

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue text does not bleed into the subjects' hair.
Ensure the 'echo' effect is perfectly vertically aligned.
Verify the suits have a visible wool-like texture.
Confirm the top metadata text is centered and small.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a diagonal group portrait + Apply a three-tier vertical typographic echo in a condensed sans-serif + Use a high-contrast primary color against a white studio background.
